question: Should gogcli support opt-in conditional Drive replacement by using the Drive v2 API solely to obtain and enforce the ETag precondition?
rationale: The implementation deliberately introduces a second Drive API version for a user-facing concurrency guarantee; whether that long-term API support contract is acceptable is a maintainer product and maintenance decision.

options.title: Approve the isolated v2 path
options.body: Accept Drive v2 only for `--if-version`, keep normal uploads on v3, and require redacted live conflict proof before merge.

options.title: Defer until a v3-compatible mechanism exists
options.body: Keep the existing unconditional replacement behavior and decline the new flag until Drive v3 exposes an acceptable atomic precondition path.

recommendation.title: Approve the isolated v2 path
recommendation.body: Accept Drive v2 only for `--if-version`, keep normal uploads on v3, and require redacted live conflict proof before merge.
